name: Claude KB
description: Search your local knowledgebase, knowledge graph, and past session history.

methods.whenToUse: Connect the Claude KB server running on this Paperclip host.
methods.guidanceMd: Run `ckb serve` on the Paperclip host, or enable the `ckb` systemd user unit so it starts with your session. Print the bearer token with `ckb serve --print-token` and paste it below.
methods.label: Use a local token

credentialFields.label: Claude KB token
credentialFields.placeholder: Paste the token from ckb serve --print-token

warnings: Claude KB listens on loopback (127.0.0.1) only. It works for agents running on this host, not for remote sandboxes such as Daytona, and not on publicly exposed authenticated deployments.
kb_note saves durable notes into the shared knowledgebase; every other tool is read-only.
